sources.title: Basic Promotors Impact Thermodynamics and Catalyst Speciation in Homogeneous Carbonyl Hydrogenation
sources.verified_access: Final published full text in TU Delft institutional repository read; journal page 8133 and Figure 7 with caption on page 8134 checked
sources.supports: Both Mn-CNC and Beller-type Mn-PNP ester hydrogenation; Figure 7 and text identify benzyl alcohol binding to Mn-PNP amido 8 to form alkoxide adduct 9 and base-dependent equilibrium/speciation. Base modulation of alcohol binding and inhibited states in Mn-PNP is established precedent, not a new project claim
sources.limits: Ester hydrogenation and alcohol-product inhibition; not direct validation of the current borrowing-hydrogen amine/imine branching and reversible-dormancy joint causal mechanism. Figure 7A catalytic conditions must not be substituted for Figure 7B UV-vis equilibrium conditions or the user's toluene conditions
